name: PCM (Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics)
description: This sub-stream is engineered for students who want to build a career in technology, engineering, architecture, software development, data science, and aviation.
interestsRequired: Mathematical Aptitude: A genuine love for solving complex equations and grinding through numerical problems.
Tech & Logic Driven: Curiosity about how software code executes, how machines operate, or how structural systems are built.
Problem-Solving Mindset: Enjoying logical puzzles, spatial reasoning, and analytical thinking.

entranceExams.name: JEE Main & JEE Advanced
entranceExams.purpose: For admission into premium engineering institutes like IITs, NITs, and IIITs.

entranceExams.name: BITSAT
entranceExams.purpose: Entrance exam for all branches of BITS (Birla Institute of Technology and Science).

entranceExams.name: NATA
entranceExams.purpose: National Aptitude Test in Architecture (mandatory for B.Arch programs).

entranceExams.name: NDA
entranceExams.purpose: National Defence Academy exam to join the Indian Air Force, Navy, or Army as an officer.

name: PCB (Physics, Chemistry, Biology)
description: This sub-stream is dedicated to students aiming for careers in medicine, surgery, dentistry, pharmacy, biotechnology, nursing, and life sciences.
interestsRequired: Biological Curiosity: Deep fascination with the human body, animal life, plants, microorganisms, and diseases.
Rote Learning & Memorization: Patience and ability to memorize large amounts of theoretical text, complex structural diagrams, and scientific nomenclature.
Research & Healthcare Instincts: Interest in clinical lab work, researching medical cures, or a strong desire to serve patients.

entranceExams.name: NEET-UG
entranceExams.purpose: National Eligibility cum Entrance Test. This is the single mandatory exam in India for MBBS, BDS, AYUSH, and Veterinary courses.

entranceExams.name: CUET-UG
entranceExams.purpose: Common University Entrance Test (used for getting into top central universities for B.Sc in Biotechnology, Microbiology, Agriculture, etc.).

name: PCMB (Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics, Biology)
description: This is a hybrid stream that combines both Mathematics and Biology. It keeps career pathways open for both engineering and medical fields simultaneously.
interestsRequired: Dual Academic Mastery: Equal command and interest in both abstract mathematical logic and theoretical biological sciences.
High Academic Endurance: Mental capacity to handle an extremely heavy syllabus load and intense study hours compared to other streams.
Career Flexibility: A deliberate choice to keep both tech and medical choices open until graduation from high school.

entranceExams.name: IAT (IISER Aptitude Test)
entranceExams.purpose: Conducted for admission to IISERs (Indian Institutes of Science Education and Research) and IISc Bangalore for pure research careers.

name: Commerce Stream
description: This stream focuses on the corporate ecosystem, financial management, trade, business policies, and economics.
interestsRequired: Love for Numbers & Data: Comfort with compiling sheets of financial data, analyzing corporate numbers, and studying percentages or ratios.
Corporate Interest: Natural curiosity about how startups secure funding, how corporations operate, and how global stock markets fluctuate.
Organizational Mindset: Inherently good at planning, managing money, and calculating financial risks.

entranceExams.name: CA Foundation / CSEET / ACCA
entranceExams.purpose: The entry-level exams for the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (ICAI) and Institute of Company Secretaries of India (ICSI).

entranceExams.name: IPMAT
entranceExams.purpose: Integrated Program in Management Aptitude Test (conducted by IIM Indore/Rohtak for a direct 5-year BBA+MBA integrated degree straight after 12th).

entranceExams.name: CLAT
entranceExams.purpose: Common Law Admission Test for entry into the premier National Law Universities (NLUs).

entranceExams.name: CUET-UG
entranceExams.purpose: For admission into high-ranking commerce colleges (like SRCC, LSR) for B.Com (Hons) and Economics (Hons).

name: Arts / Humanities Stream
description: This stream covers the comprehensive study of human society, history, literature, human behavior, and governance structures.

subjectTopics.subject: History
topics: Ancient, Medieval, and Modern Indian Civilizations

subjectTopics.subject: Geography
topics: Fundamentals of Physical Geography (Climate, Oceans, Landforms)

interestsRequired: Extensive Reading & Writing: A genuine passion for reading vast quantities of literature, text documents, and writing subjective, analytical essays.
Socio-Political Awareness: Keen interest in current affairs, historical events, cultural differences, and social justice issues.
Critical Thinking: Ability to debate, challenge perspectives, and analyze abstract social issues objectively.
careerOptions: Civil Servant (IAS, IPS, IFS officers via UPSC)

entranceExams.name: CUET-UG
entranceExams.purpose: The main gateway for top-tier humanities programs at central universities like Delhi University (DU), JNU, and BHU.

entranceExams.name: CLAT / AILET
entranceExams.purpose: Law entrance exams for corporate, criminal, or civil law paths.

entranceExams.name: UCEED / NID DAT
entranceExams.purpose: National level exams for students aiming for elite Design colleges (IIT Design, National Institute of Design).

entranceExams.name: UPSC CSE (Long Term Goal)
entranceExams.purpose: While this exam is taken after graduation, an Arts degree builds the strongest underlying base for the Indian Civil Services exam syllabus.
